voices._note: PRODUCTION narration = ElevenLabs. Requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (or an ElevenLabs MCP) on the box; without it the agent falls back to Higgsfield seed_audio (a generic preset — NOT the brand voice). Look up `voices[narrator][language]`; the launcher passes narrator/language from the Dify job `options`. THREE speakers are defined — `panda` (the mascot), `customer` (the human), and `narrator` (the off-screen background voice-over) — each in `en` and `zh`. Note the naming overlap: the job option is called `narrator` and its VALUE names the speaker, so an off-screen voice-over job is `options.narrator = "narrator"`.
